description: New Year's Day: all of SERIFU/SHOGATU.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6w), 1,481 of 1,483 strings (638 distinct; the centered '・' pause lines stay); plus SHOUGATU.EXN's in-place words: the banners (Jan. 1, Shrine), the fortune-drawing narration, the wish names (Grades, Health, Love; 9-byte slots) and the fortune names (Best, Good, Fair, Poor, Doom, Okay, Late; 5-byte slots, all 4 letters), and three 'bytes' patches that rewrite the sprintf formats around the fortune name ('Uh, %s...', 'Oh, %s.', 'Lucky me! %s!!') as pair-encoded English around a raw %s. 15 sections from SHOUGATU.EXN's tables at 0x80143A40 (tools/geko_sections.py --newyear): 0 going alone, 1 Yuko, 2 Shiori, 3 Yuina, 4 Ayako, 5 Mira, 6 Mio, 7 Yukari, 8 an unused copy of Nozomi's 9, 10 Megumi, 11 Saki, 12/14 short lines, 13 Yumi. Verified in DuckStation on forced New Year's Days (force_newyear.py via xmas_run.ps1, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md "New Year's Day"): every girl's visit or phone call through the wish, the fortune (Best, Good, Fair, Poor, Doom, Okay, Late all seen in the three formats) and her reaction to it and the way home; refusing a visit and going alone; Shiori's and Yukari's kimono choices; second- and third-year runs. Checked only statically: the third-year graduation endings (not reached by forcing the year), other moods' phone answers and fortune reactions, section 8, parts 8 and 14 (turned her down / no number), natural triggers.
